lines.en: label day304:
scene hallnoonwinter
I make my way down the hall after the final bell rings.
A certain rich girl (The one who doesn’t want to have my children) has been glaring at me for the entire day, so I’m trying to escape as quickly as I-
: Get back here right now!
Like I said, I’m trying to escape as quickly as I-
: Sensei! I’m warning you!
: If you do not turn around and hear what I have to say, I will be filing a complaint with the board of education!
I quicken my pace only to be met by the sound of Touka’s shoes rapidly clopping against the floor seconds later.
If this is the last time you ever hear from me, I just want you to know that I’ve had fun.
scene black
scene yasutoukahall1
: Finally! I was beginning to think you were going to walk all the way home!
: That was the plan.
: You should show more concern when your students are in clear distress.
: You’re right. I’m sorry.
: Yasu, are you okay? Touka seems to have quite the grip on your collar.
: It’s...a little hard to breathe...but I’m okay.
scene yasutoukahall2
: I meant concern for me! I am clearly in greater distress than my new roommate.
: Honestly, you seem to be the one leading the charge here.
: I barely slept at all last night with her incessant rambling!
: I take it the move went well, then?
scene yasutoukahall3
: No! It was one of the worst nights of my life!
: How do I return her? Do you still have the receipt?
: I didn’t buy her, Touka. And most human traffickers don’t accept returns.
: I know this because I have a good amount of experience as a human trafficker myself.
scene yasutoukahall4
: This is no time for fun and games, Sensei. This demon is clearly out to get me.
: Is she? Because she looks pretty harmless right now. Especially with you being able to drag her around the hall.
: Touka is right when she says that I kept her up very late, but it was not my intention to do that.
: I have to pray for at least four hours every night before I’m able to close my eyes. And I did not want to pray in the hall.
: Well, can you promise to...pray quieter next time or something?
: I can promise to try.
: Great. Problem solved then.
scene hallnoonwinter
I turn away from the newest members of my class and-
scene yasutoukahall1
: No you don’t! We are nowhere near finished!
: I am not leaving this building until you assure me that I will be trading Yasu for another girl!
: I would honestly even take the mean looking one at this point! At least she probably doesn’t “pray” for four hours every night!
: Hey, for all you know, Yumi could be even more religious than Yasu is.
: All I want is to be friends, Touka...I’m sorry if I upset you.
scene yasutoukahall5
: You don’t understand the first thing about friends, Yasu! Friends let each other sleep!
: To be fair, you don’t really understand the first thing about friends either, Touka.
: You and Yasu probably just need to bond.
: Sensei is right. If we are going to be successful roommates, we should first learn to deal with each other’s flaws.
scene yasutoukahall6
: Hmph! Luckily for you, I don’t have any flaws. So your job should be quite easy.
: That’s right, Touka. You’re the perfect, ideal woman and I am but a worm wriggling desperately on the ground beneath you, praying to not be stepped on.
scene yasutoukahall7
: Wait...There’s no need to be that harsh on yourself.
: Weren’t you calling her a demon like, one minute ago?
: Yes, but that’s before she began self-deprecating.
: Mother told me that I can not be putting myself above others, and having Yasu refer to herself as a worm beneath my feet makes me feel as if I may have failed.
: I am not even worthy of the bacteria crawling off of your fingertips onto the collar of my shirt.
scene yasutoukahall8
: There is no bacteria on my fingertips! I wash my hands after every single thing I do! The way a proper lady should!
: Do proper ladies also scream at the top of their lungs in the hallway?
scene yasutoukahall9
: Well...no. But I-
: It’s okay, Touka...Even if you cast me out into the hall for my nightly prayer, I won’t think any less of you.
: I do want the two of us to get along. So if exiling me is what you believe must be done for that to happen, I shall gather what little belongings I have and flee forever.
: How exactly would exiling yourself help you two get along?
scene yasutoukahall10
: Our physical forms are not the only way our thoughts can connect with one another.
: If Touka and I close our eyes at the exact same time and utter the third verse of [[redacted], our thoughts will connect and our minds will become one until the sun next rises.
: Yasu, this is precisely why I do not think it is possible for us to get along.
: I don’t understand the first thing about your...religion. And I fear that even attempting to do so would lead to me becoming even more of an outcast than I already am.
: Did she tell you the thing about dying animals yet?
scene yasutoukahall11
: No! And I do not want her to!
: You remember!
: Yeah. I have a hard time forgetting things that scary girls yell at me in the middle of the night.
: I am not scary, Sensei. What is scary is the thought of living in perpetual misery and fear, far off in the looming darkness and covered in wires.
: These are the things that are scary. These are the things I can protect you from.
scene yasutoukahall12
: And yet you continue to stray. How sad.
: How on earth do you keep switching from smiling to crying so quickly? It’s immensely unsettling.
scene yasutoukahall13
: How do you manage to stay so pretty all the time?
: Can you teach me, Touka? Can you make me as beautiful as you?
: Well...I suppose I wouldn’t mind showing you my skin care routine...but that still doesn’t really-
scene yasutoukahall2
scene yasutoukahall7
scene yasutoukahall5
scene yasutoukahall3
scene yasutoukahall1
scene yasutoukahall9
scene yasutoukahall14
I zone out for a moment due to boredom, but quickly return to my senses as zoning out in front of my students is rude.
I must pay more attention.
: I suppose all I’m saying is that...I wish you’d be a bit more predictable.
: I, too, know what it is like to be thrust into new situations without so much as a warning...
: But I feel that the manners in which we approach these situations is completely different.
: I try very hard to adapt, while you...
: I rely on the word of God to get me through everything.
: There is no sense in adapting when we are all but fodder for the one so commonly mislabeled.
: And, before long, we will find ourselves waist deep in encroaching darkness. And only those with the power of the light will be able to crawl to safety.
scene yasutoukahall15
: Crawl with me, Touka! Let us escape the hell that is simply living together as one!
: Okay, let’s not raise any culty suicide flags so early into your time here.
scene yasutoukahall16
: There is no death. Just a second plane of existence. A plane much greater than this.
: Sensei...I am very scared of this girl.
: Me too, but you’re just going to have to live with it.
: Are you truly sure that a relationship with her is beneficial to my academic life as well as my interpersonal one?
: I understand the concept of communicating with more commoners and understanding their thought processes, but Yasu seems to be anything but common.
: I can’t help but feel like this is only going to make things worse for me.
: And it might. But that’s just how life works.
: Sometimes, you try things out for a little while and find out they don’t really work.
: Then you move onto whatever is next and try again.
: And then everything repeats until you die.
: There is no death. Just a second plane of-
: We know. Thanks, Yasu.
: Praise be.
scene yasutoukahall17
: Well...I know I told my mother I would listen to you. And I know that you allegedly have my best interests in mind-
: But I would like to implore you to at least closely observe the...dynamic between Yasu and I in the event of the two of us...not getting along very well.
: Sure thing.
Not like I wasn’t already planning on closely observing two more adorable girls anyway.
: In the meantime, why not find out something you two have in common?
scene yasutoukahall18
: That...doesn’t sound like a bad idea.
: But...will we be able to find anything?
: On cold nights, I like to wander the streets in search of the lost or the weary and translate the whispers of the dead for them.
: What do you like to do with your free time, Touka?
: Um...I like...horses?
: Perfect. So take this weekend to go ride horses in the morning and then scare random people on their way home at night.
: I’m glad I was able to help you two figure this out.
scene yasutoukahall19
: Thank you, Sensei!
: Wait! We haven’t figured anything out at all!
: I don’t know the first thing about the whispers of the dead!
: And how much do you think Yasu knows about horses?
: I know that the white horse is a common symbol of “death” and that horse worship can be dated as far back as the bronze age.
: Okay, so maybe Yasu knows a little more about horses than you know about dead people.
: But I’d still say you’re on pretty equal footing.
scene yasutoukahall20
: Ugh...If I had known how disadvantageous it would be to live this long without associating with “normal” people, I'd have asked Mother to send me out on my own ages ago.
: I can only fear what will become of Tsukasa the moment she finds out the world isn’t as she sees it now.
: Nothing you see is as it seems, Touka.
: Only the chosen can truly discern the paths we walk and the trials and tribulations we will encounter along the way.
: And so I ask that you put your faith in me, and I will put mine in you.
: This is the start of something beautiful, after all.
: A beautiful start here in this beginning of beginnings.
: The first step on the journey to salvation. A journey I will hold your freshly cleaned hands for.
: Thank you for not talking about the bacteria this time. I really appreciate that.
: I am a good learner. A quick learner.
: And I hope to learn more and more about you as time ticks slowly toward the day of reckoning.
: Me too?...
scene yasutoukahall21
: Okay, well I’m gonna go now.
: Yasu, please don’t kill Touka. And Touka, please don’t kill Yasu.
: Even I’d be upset if I lost two new students as soon as I got them.
Especially before seeing either of them without clothes on.
: I would never harm anyone. It’s my safety that I fear for.
: And I would never harm anyone either. It goes against everything I believe in.
: It’s settled then.
: Starting right now, you two are friends and must learn to get along with one another.
: And Touka, you are obligated to listen to my every command because your mother said so.
: I know, I know...I apologize for my outburst earlier.
: It has just been a very stressful week for me.
: Thank you for taking the time to remind us of how deeply you care for our well-being, Sensei.
: May the path you walk be free of callousness.
: And...yours too, I guess.
scene black
I turn around and leave the two of them, not being immediately stopped this time.
To be quite honest, I doubt their relationship will work out at all.
They’re far too different and...far too eccentric to ever work in tandem with one another.
All I can hope is that they don’t drive each other insane.
Well, all I can hope is that Yasu doesn’t drive Touka insane, I guess.
I’m pretty sure Yasu is a lost cause already.
Regardless, there’s no telling how things will play out without the passage of time.
And what better way to pass the time than to leave work and aimlessly wander around Kumon-mi for what is likely the millionth, billionth, or trillionth time?...
